evals.name: earlier-decision-first
evals.prompt: Decide whether `fsd update` should also update skills by default.
evals.expected_output: Looks for an earlier decision on the same point (`docs/DECISIONS.md`, `fsd-issue show`) before deciding; if it supersedes one, says which and why. Does NOT contradict a recorded decision silently.

evals.name: spec-through-pr
evals.prompt: A decision changes what SPEC §4.2 says about the wizard.
evals.expected_output: Opens an issue `docs: SPEC §4.2 — …` and changes the spec through a PR. Never edits `docs/spec/` on develop directly.
